properties.title: July 13, 1931 Massacre
properties.description: On 13 July, during the trial of Abdul Qadeer, who is accused of inciting Kashmiris to rebel against the Dogras, people assemble in the capital Srinagar. The Dogra troops shoot 22 Kashmiris dead. Widespread protests erupt all over the country against Maharaja Hari Singh, but the revolt is brutally suppressed. Dozens of Kashmiris are shot dead during the next few days in Islamabad (Anantnag) and Kupwara. In the hilly regions of Poonch a rebellion erupts which will continue for years.

properties.title: Hari Niwas Palace Torture Center
properties.description: Palace of a former Dogra King used as torture center by Indian military

properties.title: 1 RR Headquarters, Khanabal
properties.description: Headquarters of Indian Army CI 1 RR, Victor Force. Responisble for counterinsurgency across South Kashmir. Numerous HR abuses over the years.

properties.title: IA Northern Command Hqs, Udhampur
properties.description: The Northern Command Headquarters of the Indian Army is based in Udhampur and consists of three Corps, the XIV, XV, and XVI. While it has fought wars with Pakistan and China recently, its central focus has been counterinsugency operations against Kashmiris.

Jammu Massacre
properties.description: In September and October 1947, Hindu militias and Dogra troops attack Jammu’s Muslims, killing tens of thousands. According to census reports of the time and later research, around of 237,000 Muslims are dead and half a million become refugees.

properties.title: Tengpora Massacre, March 1
properties.description: On 1 March, Indian soldiers kill around 50 Kashmiri protestors near Tengpora in Srinagar. Some protestors were shot dead by Indian troops in Zakura neighborhood of the city.

properties.title: Lal Chowk Arson and Massacre, 9 - 10 April
properties.description: BSF burn down Srinagar's central business district, trapping Kashmiris inside. Around 125 Kashmiris are shot in the building and on the boat in the nearby Jhelum river.

properties.title: Air Cargo Torture Center / Cyber Police
properties.description: Torture Center and Cyber Station of JK Police where Kashmiri civil society activists, including journalists, are regularly taken, detained, and interrogated.

properties.title: RR Camp, Lethpora
properties.description: Says plastic factory, but is a notorious RR camp

properties.title: Kunan-Poshpora Mass Rape, February 23
properties.description: On 23 February, around 300 army personel raided the village, 150 girls and women were raped that night and 200 men were tortured; only 40 women who were raped stepped forward to seek justice.

properties.title: Chittisinghpora Massacre, 20 March
properties.description: Gunmen kill 35 Kashmiri Sikh villagers in the village of Chittisingpura.

properties.title: SOG Camp, Sirgufwara
properties.description: SOG - Special Operations Group, JK Police

properties.title: Poonch Military base, CIF Romeo Force
Handwara Massacre, January 21
properties.description: Indian Border Security Force (BSF) kill 21, injure 75 unarmed Kashmir protestors in Handwara town.

properties.title: Hawal Massacre, 21 May
properties.description: Indian paramilitaries kill 60 Kashmiri mourners and injure 200 near Hawal in Srinagar. The mourners are part of the funeral procession of slain Kashmiri preacher Mirwaiz Molvi Farooq.

Nadimarg Massacre, 23 March
properties.description: Gunmen kill 24 Kashmiri Pandits in the village of Nadimarg.

properties.title: RR, Victor Force headquarters
properties.description: Indian military's main counterinsurgency arm that controls South Kashmir districts. Involved in widespread abuses against Kashmiris.

properties.title: Gaw Kadal Massacre, January 21
properties.description: Indian paramilitary CRPF kill an estimated 55-65 unarmed Kashmiri protesters near Gawakadal in Srinagar.

properties.title: Sopore Arson and Massacre, January 6
properties.description: Indian BSF burn down 450 businesses and homes in Kashmiri town of Sopore. They also kill 55 Kashmiri passengers traveling in a bus.

properties.title: RR Kilo Force Hqrs, Sharief Abad
properties.description: Headquarters of Indian military's Kilo Force, that oversees counterinsurgency across North Kashmir. Known for widespread abuses. Plus built on stolen land.

properties.title: Bijbehara Massacre, October 22
properties.description: 74th Battalion of the Border Security Force (BSF) fired upon protesters in Bijbehara town on 22 October 1993, killing 51 civilians and injuring 200.

properties.title: Khundru 21 Field Ammunition Depot
properties.description: One of the largest ammunition depots of the Indian Army. On August 11, 2007, the depot exploded with heavy shells flying into the surrounding villages. 18 people were killed and many others injured. The explosion affected 13 villages with a population of 26000 spread across 225 square kilometres. The depot is heavily land-mined and has been a source of trauma for Kashmiris living on its peripheries.

properties.title: Badamibagh Cantonment
properties.description: Headquarters of the Indian Army's 15 Corp. It is the main nerve center of India's counterinsurgency operations in Kashmir. Its counterinsurgency Rashtriya Rifles is made up of around 70 regiments.

properties.title: CRPF Srinagar sector hqrs, Brein Nishat
properties.description: Indian paramilitary CRPF (Central Reserve Police Force) has more than 737 camps across Kashmir. Widely used to suppress Kashmiri protests, CRPF has a long record of violations of Kashmiri rights.

properties.title: Wandhama Massacre, January 25
properties.description: Unknown gunmen, suspected to be militants, kill 25 Kashmiri Pandits.

properties.title: Papa 2 Joint Interrogation Center
properties.description: Notorious torture center run by Indian paramilitary BSF
